pull_request_disposition.publication_gate: Do not publish until GitHub Support confirms removal of sensitive cached views and pull-request references, or the operator explicitly accepts each remaining disclosure.

rewrite.scope: Only the retained main branch and two retained tags.
blob_replacement_classes: Machine-specific shared macOS root becomes a portable path placeholder.
Owner-specific macOS and Linux home roots become a home-directory placeholder.
The owner's personal email becomes the verified GitHub noreply address.
rewrite.identity_rule: Rewrite matching owner author, committer, and tagger email fields to 5173810+pablontiv@users.noreply.github.com; preserve names, dates, messages, and non-owner identities.
rewrite.tag_rule: Recreate roadmap-v1 and roadmap-v2 as rewritten annotated tags pointing only into rewritten history.
rewrite.signature_rule: Treat signatures invalidated by rewritten object IDs as historical and require signed commits for new work after protection is enabled.

surface_audit.projects_v2: unknown: current token lacks read:project; manual review remains mandatory

execution_controls: Generate a separate execution envelope immediately before mutation. It must pin the exact source main SHA, this plan digest, every current ref listing digest, replacement payload digest, and expected rewritten refs.
Stop if any ref, pull request, tag, visibility setting, or source object differs from the approved execution envelope.
Create and verify the rewritten repository offline before any remote mutation.
Require test/ci-local.sh, sensitive-pattern scans, object reachability checks, and independent review on the exact rewritten candidate.
Obtain explicit operator approval of the execution-envelope SHA-256 digest.
Delete obsolete ordinary heads and refs/dolt/data, force-update only main and the two retained tags, then reread every advertised ref.
Never attempt to push, delete, or treat GitHub-managed refs/pull entries as cleaned; use GitHub Support where the data is sensitive.
Do not change visibility or apply desired-state.json as part of history cleanup.
Stop after any failed request or mismatched reread; do not retry automatically.
postconditions: The remote advertises exactly one ordinary head: main.
The remote advertises exactly roadmap-v1 and roadmap-v2 as tags, both rooted in rewritten main history.
All reachable rewritten blobs, commit metadata, commit messages, and tag metadata pass the approved sensitive-pattern scan.
The rewritten main tip preserves the canonical .workspace/config.yaml content and AGENTS.md authority pointer.
test/ci-local.sh passes on the exact rewritten main tip and an independent reviewer approves that SHA.
The repository remains private until pull-request purge and every desired-state.json precondition pass.
